title: Portal sales reports
description: A month of sales split by channel (portal plan P5.2; spec §Operations, D2190). A report is derived from the ledger's entries and never from a counter, so a report and the ledger cannot disagree, and a comped key is not revenue: the free seat is a grant, and a figure that counted it would make it look like a sale. Months are UTC, and a reseller's receivable is its statements' total rather than a second calculation of the same accrual. Every object here is closed, because ee/keyservice/wire_reports.go decodes it with DisallowUnknownFields.

month.description: One month's report, as the operations team reads it.
The month the report is for, as `YYYY-MM` in UTC — the same spelling a statement carries, so the two can be read side by side.

direct_micros.description: What customers bought directly in the month, in micro-dollars. It is signed as the ledger's lines are, so a month whose only direct event was a refund is negative. A comped customer is not in it: a comped seat is a grant and not revenue (P5.2).

reseller_micros.description: What was sold through resellers in the month, in micro-dollars. It is a second figure and not a split of the first: the two are what the operations team reads, and neither is derived from the other.

customers.description: Every customer the month had a line for, including ones whose amount came to nothing: a customer with no amount is a fact a report is read for, and leaving them out would hide a month that never happened.

customer.description: One customer's line in one month.

organisation_id.description: The customer organisation the money came from.

name.description: Its name, so the report reads as a list of customers and not of ids.

channel.description: Whether this month's money came in directly or through a reseller. It is the month's channel and not the customer's: a customer a reseller sold to in March and who bought directly in April appears once under each month's own channel.

amount_micros.description: What that customer paid in the month, in micro-dollars, signed as the ledger's lines are: a month of refunds is a negative figure and not an empty one, and a comped customer's line is zero.
